svg.title: Before you ship hybrid search
svg.text: Three checks and a decision, from today's measurements.
ranking low is still a leak
weighted fusion (0.7 dense + 0.3 BM25): no miss in the top 3
RRF kept as the no-labels alternative: nothing to tune
never add raw scores from different retrievers
next: Day 09 tests a reranker on the same 81 queries
